context: Sho and Hina take photos with a camera.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、カメラ、撮影、しよう。
lines.style: Bright, clear proposition from an eight-year-old. Opening with genuine excitement—not performed, not loud-loud, but the real sunny warmth of a kid with an idea she loves. Inviting him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah. I'll try really hard to take good ones.
lines.style: Soft commitment. Six-year-old sincerity without pretense. Quiet certainty—he understands the task matters to her. Small warm smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Genuine appreciative delight. Still bright, still eight years old, but settling into the real pleasure of it. The enthusiasm is authentic—she's discovering the joy in real time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet and slightly wondering. Six-year-old perception that lands deeper than expected. Soft, steady, almost philosophical for a moment. He means it completely.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Soft closing. Eight-year-old warmth and gratitude without performance. The contentment of being with someone who gets it. Trailing into gentle quiet.
